latest_result: Kenanga public FCPO Daily Preview reports were tested as a supporting-source experiment. They clearly provide FCPO-specific daily reports and contract context, but their text layer does not safely reconstruct a complete 3rd-month OHLCV row without relying on ambiguous PDF layout. Leverage therefore keeps Kenanga for cross-check/context and continues searching for structured historical OHLCV. TA Futures was also confirmed as a public current-day OHLCV display source, but a historical backfill path is still unresolved.
